description: This is a React functional component for the home page/dashboard of a web application. It manages state related to user authentication, sidebar navigation, and dynamically renders components such as Sidebar, DashboardHeader, AuthPanel, and ProjectsList. It interacts with authentication hooks and types, handles login/logout processes, and displays project or space data based on the active service (Jira or Confluence).

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Handles user authentication process, calls login function with selected service and credentials, manages redirection for OAuth.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by calling the logout function.

methods.name: getSectionTitle
methods.description: Returns the dynamic title for the dashboard section based on connection status.

methods.name: getSectionSubtitle
methods.description: Returns a descriptive subtitle based on the current connection status and active service.
